verses.arabicText: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا
verses.transliteration: Hal atā ʿalā l-insāni ḥīnum-mina d-dahri lam yakun shayam-madhkūran
verses.translation: Is there not a period of time when each human is nothing yet worth mentioning

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Innā khalaqnā l-insāna min-nuṭ'fatin amshājin-nabtalīhi fajaʿalnāhu samīʿan baṣīran
verses.translation: ˹For˺ indeed, We ˹alone˺ created humans from a drop of mixed fluids, ˹in order˺ to test them, so We made them hear and see

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًۭا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
verses.transliteration: Innā hadaynāhu s-sabīla immā shākiraw-wa-immā kafūran
verses.translation: We already showed them the Way, whether they ˹choose to˺ be grateful or ungrateful

verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًۭا وَسَعِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Innā aʿtadnā lil'kāfirīna salāsilā wa-aghlālaw-wasaʿīran
verses.translation: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a blazing Fire

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍۢ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
verses.transliteration: Inna l-abrāra yashrabūna min kasin kāna mizājuhā kāfūran
verses.translation: Indeed, the virtuous will have a drink ˹of pure wine˺—flavoured with camphor—

verses.arabicText: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًۭا
verses.transliteration: ʿaynay-yashrabu bihā ʿibādu l-lahi yufajjirūnahā tafjīran
verses.translation: ˹from˺ a spring where Allah’s servants will drink, flowing at their will

verses.arabicText: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًۭا
verses.transliteration: Yūfūna bil-nadhri wayakhāfūna yawman kāna sharruhu mus'taṭīran
verses.translation: They ˹are those who˺ fulfil ˹their˺ vows and fear a Day of sweeping horror

verses.arabicText: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًۭا وَيَتِيمًۭا وَأَسِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Wayuṭ'ʿimūna ṭ-ṭaʿāma ʿalā ḥubbihi mis'kīnaw-wayatīman wa-asīran
verses.translation: and give food—despite their desire for it—to the poor, the orphan, and the captive

verses.arabicText: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَلَا شُكُورًا
verses.transliteration: Innamā nuṭ'ʿimukum liwajhi l-lahi lā nurīdu minkum jazāaw-walā shukūran
verses.translation: ˹saying to themselves,˺ “We feed you only for the sake of Allah, seeking neither reward nor thanks from you

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًۭا قَمْطَرِيرًۭا
verses.transliteration: Innā nakhāfu mir-rabbinā yawman ʿabūsan qamṭarīran
verses.translation: We fear from our Lord a horribly distressful Day.”

verses.arabicText: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةًۭ وَسُرُورًۭا
verses.transliteration: Fawaqāhumu l-lahu sharra dhālika l-yawmi walaqqāhum naḍrataw-wasurūran
verses.translation: So Allah will deliver them from the horror of that Day, and grant them radiance and joy

verses.arabicText: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةًۭ وَحَرِيرًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wajazāhum bimā ṣabarū jannataw-waḥarīran
verses.translation: and reward them for their perseverance with a Garden ˹in Paradise˺ and ˹garments of˺ silk

verses.arabicText: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًۭا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًۭا
verses.transliteration: Muttakiīna fīhā ʿalā l-arāiki lā yarawna fīhā shamsaw-walā zamharīran
verses.translation: There they will be reclining on ˹canopied˺ couches, never seeing scorching heat or bitter cold

verses.arabicText: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wadāniyatan ʿalayhim ẓilāluhā wadhullilat quṭūfuhā tadhlīlan
verses.translation: The Garden’s shade will be right above them, and its fruit will be made very easy to reach

verses.arabicText: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍۢ مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
verses.transliteration: Wayuṭāfu ʿalayhim biāniyatim-min fiḍḍatiw-wa-akwābin kānat qawārīrā
verses.translation: They will be waited on with silver vessels and cups of crystal—

verses.arabicText: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًۭا
verses.transliteration: Qawārīrā min fiḍḍatin qaddarūhā taqdīran
verses.translation: crystalline silver, filled precisely as desired

verses.arabicText: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Wayus'qawna fīhā kasan kāna mizājuhā zanjabīlan
verses.translation: And they will be given a drink ˹of pure wine˺ flavoured with ginger

verses.arabicText: عَيْنًۭا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًۭا
verses.transliteration: ʿaynan fīhā tusammā salsabīlan
verses.translation: from a spring there, called Salsabîl

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًۭا مَّنثُورًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wayaṭūfu ʿalayhim wil'dānum-mukhalladūna idhā ra-aytahum ḥasib'tahum lu'lu-am-manthūran
verses.translation: They will be waited on by eternal youths. If you saw them, you would think they were scattered pearls

verses.arabicText: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًۭا وَمُلْكًۭا كَبِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-idhā ra-ayta thamma ra-ayta naʿīmaw-wamul'kan kabīran
verses.translation: And if you looked around, you would see ˹indescribable˺ bliss and a vast kingdom

verses.arabicText: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا
verses.transliteration: ʿāliyahum thiyābu sundusin khuḍ'ruw-wa-is'tabraqun waḥullū asāwira min fiḍḍatiw-wasaqāhum rabbuhum sharāban ṭahūran
verses.translation: The virtuous will be ˹dressed˺ in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade, and adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
verses.transliteration: Inna hādhā kāna lakum jazāaw-wakāna saʿyukum mashkūran
verses.translation: ˹And they will be told,˺ “All this is surely a reward for you. Your striving has been appreciated.”

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا
verses.transliteration: Innā naḥnu nazzalnā ʿalayka l-qur'āna tanzīlan
verses.translation: Indeed, it is We Who have revealed the Quran to you ˹O Prophet˺ in stages

verses.arabicText: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا
verses.transliteration: Fa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika walā tuṭiʿ min'hum āthiman aw kafūran
verses.translation: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not yield to any evildoer or ˹staunch˺ disbeliever from among them

verses.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-udh'kuri is'ma rabbika buk'rataw-wa-aṣīlan
verses.translation: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening

verses.arabicText: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًۭا طَوِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Wamina al-layli fa-us'jud lahu wasabbiḥ'hu laylan ṭawīlan
verses.translation: and prostrate before Him during part of the night, and glorify Him long at night

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا
verses.transliteration: Inna hāulāi yuḥibbūna l-ʿājilata wayadharūna warāahum yawman thaqīlan
verses.translation: Surely those ˹pagans˺ love this fleeting world, ˹totally˺ neglecting a weighty Day ahead of them

verses.arabicText: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Naḥnu khalaqnāhum washadadnā asrahum wa-idhā shi'nā baddalnā amthālahum tabdīlan
verses.translation: It is We Who created them and perfected their ˹physical˺ form. But if We will, We can easily replace them with others

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا
verses.transliteration: Inna hādhihi tadhkiratun faman shāa ittakhadha ilā rabbihi sabīlan
verses.translation: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord

verses.arabicText: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wamā tashāūna illā ay-yashāa l-lahu inna l-laha kāna ʿalīman ḥakīman
verses.translation: But you cannot will ˹to do so˺ unless Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise

verses.arabicText: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
verses.transliteration: Yud'khilu may-yashāu fī raḥmatihi wal-ẓālimīna aʿadda lahum ʿadhāban alīman
verses.translation: He admits whoever He wills into His mercy. As for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment
